## Set-up

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(readstata13)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(scales)
library(modelsummary)
library(knitr)
library(fixest)
library(broom)

setwd("/Users/enzowei/Documents/Warwick/3rd Year/RAE Dissertation/Running environment")
SDD_SALSUS_2000to2018 <- c("salsus2002.dta",
                "sdd02engarchive.dta",
                "salsus2004.dta",
                "sdd04_eng_archive.dta",
                "sdd06_eng_archive.dta",
                "salsus_2006_data.dta",
                "sdd08_pupil_data.dta",
                "sdd10_archive.dta",
                "salsus_2008_to_ukda.dta",
                "salsus_2010_to_ukda.dta",
                "salsus_2013_ukda.dta",
                "sdd13_for_data_archive.dta",
                "salsus_2018_for_ukda.dta",
                "sdd_dataforarchive_2018.dta",
                "sdd00dataeng.dta",
                "salsus00datascot.dta")

for (x in SDD_SALSUS_2000to2018) {
  df_name <- sub("\\.dta$", "", basename(x))
  assign(df_name, read.dta13(x), envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

salsus_trend_data_1990_to_2013 <- read.dta13("salsus_trend_data_1990_to_2013.dta")
```

## Variables extraction

### \[Year 2000\]

#### Scotland

```{r}
#2000
#Scotland
year2000_scotland <- salsus00datascot %>%
  transmute(
    country,
    survey_year,
    age             = age1115,
    truant_raw      = truant,
    gender_raw      = sex,
    schoolstage_raw = syear,
    smokernow_raw   = cgnow,
    smokestat_raw   = cgstat,
    cgfamn_raw      = cgfamn,
    cgfams_raw      = cgfams,
    cgfamz_raw      = cgfamz,
    drinkfreq_raw   = alfreq,
    everdrink_raw   = alevr,
    ethnicity_raw   = ethnic,
    druguse_raw     = ddgyr
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    truant = case_when(
      truant_raw == "yes" ~ 1,
      truant_raw == "no" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    gender = case_when(
      gender_raw == "boy" ~ 1,
      gender_raw == "girl" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    schoolstage = case_when(
      schoolstage_raw == "year 7" ~ "year 7/P7/age 10~11",
      schoolstage_raw == "year 8/s1" ~ "year 8/S1/age 11~12",
      schoolstage_raw == "year 9/s2" ~ "year 9/S2/age 12~13",
      schoolstage_raw == "year 10/s3" ~ "year 10/S3/age 13~14",
      schoolstage_raw == "year 11/s4" ~ "year 11/S4/age 14~15+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    smokernow = case_when(
      smokernow_raw == "yes" ~ 1,
      smokernow_raw == "no" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    smoking_status = case_when(
      smokestat_raw == "i have never smoked" ~ "Never smoked",
      smokestat_raw == "i have only ever tried smoking once" ~ "Tried smoking",
      smokestat_raw == "i used to smoke sometimes but i never smoke a cigarette now" ~ "Used to smoke",
      smokestat_raw == "i sometimes smoke cigarettes now but i don't smoke as many a" ~ "Occasional smoker (<1/week)",
      smokestat_raw == "i usually smoke between one and six cigarettes a week" ~ "Regular smoker (1-6/week)",
      smokestat_raw == "i usually smoke more than six cigarettes a week" ~ "Regular smoker (>6/week)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    everdrink = case_when(
      everdrink_raw == "yes" ~ 1,
      everdrink_raw == "no" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    drinkfreq = case_when(
      drinkfreq_raw == "i never drink alcohol now" ~ "Never",
      everdrink_raw == "no" ~ "Never",
      drinkfreq_raw == "only a few times a year" ~ "Few times a year",
      drinkfreq_raw == "about once a month" ~ "Once a month",
      drinkfreq_raw == "about once a fortnight" ~ "Once a fortnight",
      drinkfreq_raw == "about once a week" ~ "Once a week",
      drinkfreq_raw == "about twice a week" ~ "Twice a week",
      drinkfreq_raw == "almost every day" ~ "Everyday",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    ethnicity = case_when(
      ethnicity_raw == "white" ~ "White",
      ethnicity_raw == "mixed" ~ "Mixed",
      ethnicity_raw %in% c("asian or asian british", "chinese") ~ "Asian",
      ethnicity_raw == "black or black british" ~ "Black",
      ethnicity_raw == "Other" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    cgfamn_raw = case_when(
      cgfamn_raw %in% c("not answered (9)", "item not applicable") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamn_raw)
    ),
    cgfams_raw = case_when(
      cgfams_raw %in% c("not answered (9)", "item not applicable") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfams_raw)
    ),
    cgfamz_raw = case_when(
      cgfamz_raw %in% c("not answered (9)", "item not applicable") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamz_raw)
    ),
    
    cgfamatt_raw = case_when(
      !is.na(cgfamn_raw) ~ cgfamn_raw,
      !is.na(cgfams_raw) & cgfams_raw != "they don't know i smoke" ~ cgfams_raw,
      cgfams_raw == "they don't know i smoke" ~ cgfamz_raw,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    cgfamatt = case_when(
      cgfamatt_raw %in% c("they would stop me",
                          "they stop me",
                          "they try to persuade me not to smoke",
                          "they would try to persuade me not to smoke") ~ "Negative",
      cgfamatt_raw %in% c("they do nothing",
                          "they would do nothing")  ~ "Neutral",
      cgfamatt_raw %in% c("they encourage me to smoke",
                          "they would encourage me to smoke")  ~ "Positive",
      cgfamatt_raw %in% c("i don't know") ~ "Don't know",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    druguse = case_when(
      druguse_raw == 1 ~ 1,
      druguse_raw == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

### \[Year 2002\]

#### Scotland

```{r}
#2002
#Scotland
year2002_scotland <- salsus2002 %>%
  transmute(
    country,
    survey_year,
    truant_raw      = truant,
    gender_raw      = sex,
    schoolstage_raw = classyr,
    smokernow_raw   = cgnow,
    smokestat_raw   = cgstat,
    cgfamn_raw      = cgfamn,
    cgfams_raw      = cgfams,
    cgfamz_raw      = cgfamz,
    dcgfam_raw      = dcgfam,
    everdrink_raw   = alevr,
    drinkfreq_raw   = alfreq,
    ethnicity_raw   = dethgrp,
    druguse_raw     = ddgyr
  ) %>%
  
  #measurement bias adjusted
  mutate(
    truant = case_when(
      truant_raw %in% c("3 times",
                        "4 times",
                        "5 times",
                        "Between 6 and 10 times",
                        "More than 10 times") ~ 1,
      truant_raw %in% c("None at all",
                        "Once",
                        "Twice") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    #alternative strict truant recoding
    alt_truant = case_when(
      truant_raw %in% c("Once",
                        "Twice",
                        "3 times",
                        "4 times",
                        "5 times",
                        "Between 6 and 10 times",
                        "More than 10 times") ~ 1,
      truant_raw %in% c("None at all") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    gender = case_when(
      gender_raw == "male" ~ 1,
      gender_raw == "female" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    schoolstage = case_when(
      schoolstage_raw == "S2" ~ "year 9/S2/age 12~13",
      schoolstage_raw == "S4" ~ "year 11/S4/age 14~15+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    smokernow = case_when(
      smokernow_raw == 1 ~ 1,
      smokernow_raw == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    smoking_status = case_when(
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i have never smoked" ~ "Never smoked",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i have only ever tried smoking once" ~ "Tried smoking",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i used to smoke sometimes but not now" ~ "Used to smoke",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i sometimes smoke but not as many as 1 a week" ~ "Occasional smoker (<1/week)",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i usually smoke between 1 and 6 cigarettes a week" ~ "Regular smoker (1-6/week)",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i usually smoke more than 6 cigarettes a week" ~ "Regular smoker (>6/week)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    everdrink = case_when(
      everdrink_raw == "Yes" ~ 1,
      everdrink_raw == "No" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    drinkfreq = case_when(
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "i never drink alcohol now" ~ "Never",
      everdrink_raw          == "No" ~ "Never",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "only a few times a year" ~ "Few times a year",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a month" ~ "Once a month",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a fortnight" ~ "Once a fortnight",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a week" ~ "Once a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about twice a week" ~ "Twice a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "almost every day" ~ "Everyday",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    ethnicity = case_when(
      ethnicity_raw == "White" ~ "White",
      ethnicity_raw == "Mixed" ~ "Mixed",
      tolower(ethnicity_raw) %in% c("india", 
                                    "chinese", 
                                    "pakistani",
                                    "bangladeshi") ~ "Asian",
      tolower(ethnicity_raw) %in% c("black african",
                                    "black caribbean",
                                    "black other") ~ "Black",
      ethnicity_raw == "Other" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    cgfamn_raw = case_when(
      cgfamn_raw %in% c("not answered", "not applicable") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamn_raw)
    ),
    cgfams_raw = case_when(
      cgfams_raw %in% c("not answered", "not applicable") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfams_raw)
    ),
    cgfamz_raw = case_when(
      cgfamz_raw %in% c("not answered", "not applicable") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamz_raw)
    ),
    
    cgfamatt = case_when(
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("they would stop me",
                         "persuade me not to") ~ "Negative",
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("do nothing")  ~ "Neutral",
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("encourage me")  ~ "Positive",
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("not sure") ~ "Don't know",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    druguse = case_when(
      druguse_raw == 1 ~ 1,
      druguse_raw == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
                        "Between 6 and 10 times",
                        "More than 10 times") ~ 1,
      truant_raw %in% c("Not at all" ) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    gender = case_when(
      gender_raw == "Boy" ~ 1,
      gender_raw == "Girl" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    schoolstage = case_when(
      schoolstage_raw == "Secondary 2" ~ "year 9/S2/age 12~13",
      schoolstage_raw == "Secondary 4" ~ "year 11/S4/age 14~15+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    smokernow = case_when(
      smokernow_raw == "Yes" ~ 1,
      smokernow_raw == "No" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    smoking_status = case_when(
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i have never smoked" ~ "Never smoked",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i have only ever tried smoking once" ~ "Tried smoking",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i used to smoke but never smoke now" ~ "Used to smoke",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i sometimes smoke but not as many as one a week" ~
                                "Occasional smoker (<1/week)",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i smoke between one and six cigarettes a week" ~ "Regular smoker (1-6/week)",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i smoke more than six cigarettes a week" ~ "Regular smoker (>6/week)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    everdrink = case_when(
      everdrink_raw == "Yes" ~ 1,
      everdrink_raw == "No" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    drinkfreq = case_when(
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "i never drink alcohol now" ~ "Never",
      tolower(everdrink_raw) == "no" ~ "Never",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "only a few times a year" ~ "Few times a year",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a month" ~ "Once a month",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a fortnight" ~ "Once a fortnight",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a week" ~ "Once a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about twice a week" ~ "Twice a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "almost every day" ~ "Everyday",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    ethnicity = case_when(
      ethnicity_raw == "White" ~ "White",
      ethnicity_raw == "Mixed" ~ "Mixed",
      tolower(ethnicity_raw) %in% c("indian", 
                                    "chinese", 
                                    "pakistani",
                                    "bangladeshi") ~ "Asian",
      tolower(ethnicity_raw) %in% c("black african",
                                    "black caribbean",
                                    "black other") ~ "Black",
      ethnicity_raw == "Other" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    cgfamn_raw = case_when(
      cgfamn_raw %in% c("not answered", "not applicable") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamn_raw)
    ),
    cgfams_raw = case_when(
      cgfams_raw %in% c("not answered", "not applicable") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfams_raw)
    ),
    cgfamz_raw = case_when(
      cgfamz_raw %in% c("not answered", "not applicable") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamz_raw)
    ),
    
    cgfamatt = case_when(
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("they would stop me",
                         "persuade me not to") ~ "Negative",
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("do nothing")  ~ "Neutral",
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("encourage me")  ~ "Positive",
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("not sure") ~ "Don't know",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    druguse = case_when(
      druguse_raw == 1 ~ 1,
      druguse_raw == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
      cgfams_raw %in% c("not applicable", "not answered", "don't know (5)") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfams_raw)
    ),
    cgfamz_raw = case_when(
      cgfamz_raw %in% c("not applicable", "not answered", "don't know (5)") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamz_raw)
    ),
    
    cgfamatt = case_when(
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("try to stop me",
                        "try to persuade me to stop") ~ "Negative",
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("do nothing")  ~ "Neutral",
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("encourage me to smoke")  ~ "Positive",
      dcgfam_raw %in% c("don't know") ~ "Don't know",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    druguse = case_when(
      druguse_raw == "used drugs" ~ 1,
      druguse_raw == "not used" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#2008
#Scotland
year2008_scotland <- salsus_2008_to_ukda %>%

    drinkfreq_raw   = alfreq,
    #ethnicity is multi-variable
    scottish,
    english,
    welsh,
    irish,
    gtrav,
    polish,
    nirish,
    british,
    whoth,
    indian,
    pakist,
    bangla,
    chinese,
    asianoth,
    blkcar,
    blkafr,
    blkscbr,
    blkother,
    mixed,
    otharab,
    otheth,
    ethdk,
    #drug used is defined by many variables
    dgtake,
    dgfqcan,
    dgfqgas,
    dgfqamp,
    dgfqlsd,
    dgfqecs,
    dgfqsem,
    dgfqpop,
    dgfqtrn,
    dgfqher,
    dgfqmsh,
    dgfqmth,
    dgfqcrk,
    dgfqcok,
    dgfqana,
    dgfqoth
  ) %>%
  
  #measurement bias adjusted truant
  mutate(
    truant = case_when(
      truant_raw %in% c(4,
                        5,
                        6,
                        7,
                        8) ~ 1,
      truant_raw %in% c(1,
                        2,
                        3) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
  
  #alternative strict truant recoding
    alt_truant = case_when(
      truant_raw %in% c(2,
                        3,
                        4,
                        5,
                        6,
                        7,
                        8) ~ 1,
      truant_raw %in% c(1) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    gender = case_when(
      gender_raw == 1 ~ 1,
      gender_raw == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    schoolstage = case_when(
      schoolstage_raw == "Secondary 2" ~ "year 9/S2/age 12~13",
      schoolstage_raw == "Secondary 4" ~ "year 11/S4/age 14~15+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    smokernow = case_when(
      smokernow_raw == "Yes" ~ 1,
      smokernow_raw == "No" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    smoking_status = case_when(
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == 1 ~ "Never smoked",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == 2 ~ "Tried smoking",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == 3 ~ "Used to smoke",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == 4 ~ "Occasional smoker (<1/week)",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == 5 ~ "Regular smoker (1-6/week)",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == 6 ~ "Regular smoker (>6/week)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    everdrink = case_when(
      everdrink_raw == "Yes" ~ 1,
      everdrink_raw == "No" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    drinkfreq = case_when(
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "never had a drink" ~ "Never",
      tolower(everdrink_raw) == "no" ~ "Never",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "i never drink alcohol now" ~ "Never",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "only a few times a year" ~ "Few times a year",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a month" ~ "Once a month",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a fortnight" ~ "Once a fortnight",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a week" ~ "Once a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about twice a week" ~ "Twice a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "almost every day" ~ "Everyday",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    ethnicity = case_when(
      scottish == 1 ~ "White",
      english == 1 ~ "White",
      welsh == 1 ~ "White",
      irish == 1 ~ "White",
      gtrav == 1 ~ "White",
      polish == 1 ~ "White",
      british == 1 ~ "White",
      nirish == 1 ~ "White",
      whoth == 1 ~ "White",
      indian == 1 ~ "Asian",
      pakist == 1 ~ "Asian",
      bangla == 1 ~ "Asian",
      chinese == 1 ~ "Asian",
      asianoth == 1 ~ "Asian",
      blkcar == 1 ~ "Black",
      blkafr == 1 ~ "Black",
      blkscbr == 1 ~ "Black",
      blkother == 1 ~ "Black",
      mixed == 1 ~ "Mixed",
      otharab == 1 ~ "Other",
      otheth == 1 ~ "Other",
      ethdk == 1 ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    cgfamn_raw = case_when(
      cgfamn_raw %in% c(-1, 98) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.integer(cgfamn_raw)
    ),
    cgfams_raw = case_when(
      cgfams_raw %in% c(-1, 98) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.integer(cgfams_raw)
    ),
    cgfamz_raw = case_when(
      cgfamz_raw %in% c(-1, 98) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.integer(cgfamz_raw)
    ),
    
    cgfamatt_raw = case_when(
      !is.na(cgfamn_raw) ~ cgfamn_raw,
      !is.na(cgfams_raw) & cgfams_raw != 6 ~ cgfams_raw,
      cgfams_raw == 6 ~ cgfamz_raw,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    cgfamatt = case_when(
      cgfamatt_raw %in% c(1,
                          2) ~ "Negative",
      cgfamatt_raw %in% c(3)  ~ "Neutral",
      cgfamatt_raw %in% c(4)  ~ "Positive",
      cgfamatt_raw %in% c(5) ~ "Don't know",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    druguse = case_when(
      rowSums(across(c(dgfqcan, dgfqgas, dgfqamp, dgfqlsd, dgfqecs,
                       dgfqsem, dgfqpop, dgfqtrn, dgfqher, dgfqmsh,
                       dgfqmth, dgfqcrk, dgfqcok, dgfqana, dgfqoth),
                     ~ . %in% c(1, 2)), na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 1,
      rowSums(across(c(dgfqcan, dgfqgas, dgfqamp, dgfqlsd, dgfqecs,
                       dgfqsem, dgfqpop, dgfqtrn, dgfqher, dgfqmsh,
                       dgfqmth, dgfqcrk, dgfqcok, dgfqana, dgfqoth),
                     ~ . %in% c(3, 4)), na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
      dgtake == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i used to smoke sometimes but i never smoke a cigarette now" ~ "Used to smoke",

      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a fortnight" ~ "Once a fortnight",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a week" ~ "Once a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about twice a week" ~ "Twice a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "almost every day" ~ "Everyday",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    cgfamn_raw = case_when(

      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamn_raw)
    ),
    cgfams_raw = case_when(

      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfams_raw)
    ),
    cgfamz_raw = case_when(
      cgfamz_raw %in% c("not asked / not applicable", "not answered / refused") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamz_raw)
    ),
    
    cgfamatt_raw = case_when(
      !is.na(cgfamn_raw) ~ cgfamn_raw,
      !is.na(cgfams_raw) & cgfams_raw != "They do not know I smoke" ~ cgfams_raw,
      cgfams_raw == "They do not know I smoke" ~ cgfamz_raw,

      cgfams_raw %in% c("They do nothing")  ~ "Neutral",
```

```{r}
      gender_raw == "Boy" ~ 1,
      gender_raw == "Girl" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    schoolstage = case_when(
      schoolstage_raw == "Year 7" ~ "year 7/P7/age 10~11",
      schoolstage_raw == "Year 8" ~ "year 8/S1/age 11~12",
      schoolstage_raw == "Year 9" ~ "year 9/S2/age 12~13",
      schoolstage_raw == "Year 10" ~ "year 10/S3/age 13~14",
      schoolstage_raw == "Year 11" ~ "year 11/S4/age 14~15+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    smokernow = case_when(
      smokernow_raw == "Yes" ~ 1,
      smokernow_raw == "No" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    smoking_status = case_when(
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i have never smoked" ~ "Never smoked",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i have only ever tried smoking once" ~ "Tried smoking",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i used to smoke but never now" ~ "Used to smoke",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i sometimes smoke but not as many as one a week" ~ "Occasional smoker (<1/week)",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i usually smoke between one and six a week" ~ "Regular smoker (1-6/week)",
      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i usually smoke more than six a week" ~ "Regular smoker (>6/week)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    everdrink = case_when(
      everdrink_raw == "Yes" ~ 1,
      everdrink_raw == "No" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    drinkfreq = case_when(
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "i never drink alcohol now" ~ "Never",
      tolower(everdrink_raw) == "no" ~ "Never",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "only a few times a year" ~ "Few times a year",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a month" ~ "Once a month",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a fortnight" ~ "Once a fortnight",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a week" ~ "Once a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about twice a week" ~ "Twice a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "every day or almost every day" ~ "Everyday",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    cgfamn_raw = case_when(
      cgfamn_raw %in% c("Not applicable", "Not answered", "Dont know") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamn_raw)
    ),
    cgfams_raw = case_when(
      cgfams_raw %in% c("Not applicable", "Not answered", "Dont know") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfams_raw)
    ),
    cgfamz_raw = case_when(
      cgfamz_raw %in% c("Not applicable", "Not answered", "Dont know") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(cgfamz_raw)
    ),
    
    cgfamatt = case_when(
      tolower(dcgfam_raw) %in% c("they would try to stop me",
                                 "they would try to persuade me to stop") ~ "Negative",
      tolower(dcgfam_raw) %in% c("they would do nothing")  ~ "Neutral",
      tolower(dcgfam_raw) %in% c("they would encourage me to smoke")  ~ "Positive",
      tolower(dcgfam_raw) %in% c("i don't know") ~ "Don't know",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    druguse = case_when(
      druguse_raw == "Used drugs" ~ 1,
      druguse_raw == "Not used" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
year2013_scotland <- salsus_trend_data_1990_to_2013 %>%

      tolower(smokestat_raw) == "i usually smoke more than six cigarettes a week" ~ "Regular smoker (>6/week)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    everdrink = case_when(
      everdrink_raw == "Yes" ~ 1,
      everdrink_raw == "No" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    drinkfreq = case_when(
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "never had a drink" ~ "Never",
      tolower(everdrink_raw) == "no" ~ "Never",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "i never drink alcohol now" ~ "Never",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "only a few times a year" ~ "Few times a year",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a month" ~ "Once a month",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a fortnight" ~ "Once a fortnight",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about once a week" ~ "Once a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "about twice a week" ~ "Twice a week",
      tolower(drinkfreq_raw) == "almost every day" ~ "Everyday",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    cgfamatt_smoker = case_when(
      cgfams_raw %in% c("Try to dissuade me/persuade me not to smoke",
                        "They stop me") ~ "Negative",
      cgfams_raw %in% c("They do nothing")  ~ "Neutral",
      cgfams_raw %in% c("They encourage me")  ~ "Positive",
      cgfams_raw %in% c("Dont know") ~ "Don't know",
      cgfams_raw %in% c("They do not know I smoke") ~ "They don't know",

      druguse_raw %in% c("Never taken any drugs",
                         "Taken any drugs more than a year ago") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    country = "Scotland"
  )
```

## Combined dataset construction

```{r}
#rowbind
keep_vars <- c("country", "survey_year", "truant",
               "gender", "schoolstage", "age",
               "cgfamatt", "druguse", "ethnicity",
               "drinkfreq", "everdrink", "smokernow",
               "smoking_status", "cgfamatt_smoker", "ethnicity_bin",
               "alt_truant")

df_selected <- list(#2000
                    year2000_england,
                    year2000_scotland,
                    #2002
                    year2002_england,
                    year2002_scotland,
                    #2004
                    year2004_england,
                    year2004_scotland,
                    #2006
                    year2006_england,
                    year2006_scotland,
                    #2008
                    year2008_england,
                    year2008_scotland,
                    #2010
                    year2010_england,
                    year2010_scotland,
                    #2013
                    year2013_england,
                    year2013_scotland,
                    #2018
                    year2018_england,
                    year2018_scotland)

sdd_salsus_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(df_selected, function(x) x %>% select(any_of(keep_vars)))
)

#variables creates
sdd_salsus_all <- sdd_salsus_all %>%
  mutate(
    young_old = case_when(
      schoolstage %in% c("year 7/P7/age 10~11",
                        "year 8/S1/age 11~12",
                        "year 9/S2/age 12~13") ~ "Younger",
      schoolstage %in% c("year 10/S3/age 13~14",
                         "year 11/S4/age 14~15+") ~ "Older",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ethnicity_bin = case_when(
      ethnicity %in% c("Asian",
                       "Black",
                       "Other",
                       "Non-white") ~ "Non-white",
      ethnicity %in% c("White") ~ "White",
      ethnicity_bin == "Non-white" ~ "Non-white",
      ethnicity_bin == "White" ~ "White",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    drinkfreq_num = case_when(
      drinkfreq == "Everyday" ~ 6,
      drinkfreq == "Twice a week" ~ 5,
      drinkfreq == "Once a week" ~ 4,
      drinkfreq == "Once a fortnight" ~ 3,
      drinkfreq == "Once a month" ~ 2,
      drinkfreq == "Few times a year" ~ 1,
      drinkfreq == "Never" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    weekly_drinker = case_when(
      drinkfreq %in% c("Everyday",
                       "Twice a week",
                       "Once a week") ~ 1,
      drinkfreq %in% c("Once a fortnight",
                       "Once a month",
                       "Few times a year",
                       "Never") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    weekly_smoker = case_when(
      smoking_status %in% c("Regular smoker (>6/week)",
                            "Regular smoker (1-6/week)") ~ 1,
      smoking_status %in% c("Never smoked",
                            "Occasional smoker (<1/week)",
                            "Tried smoking",
                            "Used to smoke") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    alternative_truant = case_when(
      alt_truant == 1 ~ 1,
      alt_truant == 0 ~ 0,
      is.na(alt_truant) & country %in% c("England") ~ truant,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    post = ifelse(survey_year >= 2013, 1, 0),
    fixest_treatment = ifelse(country == "Scotland", 1, 0),
    did = fixest_treatment * post
  )
```

### Sample statistics

```{r}

sumstats <- sdd_salsus_all %>%
  mutate(
    ever = as.numeric(truant)   #ensures 0/1 numeric
  ) %>%
  group_by(country, survey_year) %>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(!is.na(ever)),
    mean_ever = mean(ever, na.rm = TRUE),        #proportion
    se = sqrt(mean_ever * (1 - mean_ever) / N),  #standard error of a proportion
    ci_low = mean_ever - 1.96 * se,
    ci_high = mean_ever + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_ever = 100 * mean_ever,
    ci_low_pct = 100 * ci_low,
    ci_high_pct = 100 * ci_high
  )
```

```{r}

bin_vars <- c(

plot_df <- sdd_salsus_all %>%

    )

  select(country, truant, all_of(bin_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(bin_vars),

    ci_high = p + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = recode(variable, !!!var_labels),
    label = percent(truancy_rate, accuracy = 1)
  )

gap <- 0.10
strip_half <- 0.10

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    side_rate = ifelse(value == 1, -(truancy_rate + gap), truancy_rate + gap),
    side_low  = ifelse(value == 1, -(ci_high + gap), ci_low + gap),
    side_high = ifelse(value == 1, -(ci_low + gap), ci_high + gap),

mid_labels <- plot_df %>%
```

## Donald and Lang (2007) inference

### Single estimate

```{r}

#1.Define treatment timing

# Adjust this if you define post differently.
# If 2010 is the reference/policy year and 2013+ is post:
post_years <- c(2013, 2018)

# Main outcome
outcome_var <- "truant"



#2.Collapse to country-year means


country_year <- sdd_salsus_all %>%
  filter(
    country %in% c("England", "Scotland"),
    !is.na(.data[[outcome_var]]),
    !is.na(survey_year)
  ) %>%
  group_by(country, survey_year) %>%
  summarise(
    y_mean = mean(.data[[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

country_year

#3.Create Scotland - England gap

dl_gap <- country_year %>%
  select(country, survey_year, y_mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = country,
    values_from = y_mean
  ) %>%
  arrange(survey_year) %>%
  mutate(
    gap_scot_eng = Scotland - England
  )

dl_gap

#4.First-difference the gap


dl_fd <- dl_gap %>%
  arrange(survey_year) %>%
  mutate(
    fd_gap = gap_scot_eng - lag(gap_scot_eng),
    fd_year = paste0(lag(survey_year), "-", survey_year),
    
    # This equals 1 for the first change into the post-treatment period.
    # For your data, this will usually be 2010-2013 if 2013 is first post year.
    dl_treat = ifelse(survey_year == min(post_years), 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fd_gap))

dl_fd


#5.Donald-Lang baseline model, First-difference gap, no intercept

dl_model_no_intercept <- lm(fd_gap ~ 0 + dl_treat, data = dl_fd)

summary(dl_model_no_intercept)
tidy(dl_model_no_intercept, conf.int = TRUE)
```

### Baseline specification

```{r}
#baseline linear
fe_linear_baseline <- feols(truant ~ i(survey_year, fixest_treatment, ref = 2010) | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, vcov = "hetero")
summary(fe_linear_baseline)

iplot(fe_linear_baseline, ref.line = 0,
      xlab = "Year",
      ylab = "Effect on truant (pp, ref=2010)",
      main = "LPM Event-study no control")
```

```{r}
summary(fe_probit_baseline)

iplot(fe_probit_baseline, ref.line = 0,
      xlab = "Year",
      ylab = "Effect on truant (pp, ref=2010)",
      main = "Event-study: 2010 Alcohol Act on Truancy, baseline specification")
```

### Specification with controls for characteristics and risk behaviour

#### \[Linear model\]

```{r}
#fe linear with controls for characteristics and risky behaviour
fe_linear_controls <- feols(truant ~ survey_year + gender + young_old + smokernow + druguse + i(survey_year, fixest_treatment, ref = 2010) | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, vcov = "hetero")
summary(fe_linear_controls)

iplot(fe_linear_controls, ref.line = 0,
      xlab = "Year",
      ylab = "Effect on truant (pp, ref=2010)",
      main = "LPM event-study controls for gender, young/old and substance use")
```

#### \[Probit model\]

```{r}
#fe probit with controls for characteristics and risky behaviour
fe_probit_controls <- feglm(truant ~ survey_year + gender + young_old + smokernow + druguse + i(survey_year, fixest_treatment, ref = 2010) | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, family = "probit", vcov = "hetero")
summary(fe_probit_controls)

iplot(fe_probit_controls, ref.line = 0,
      xlab = "Year",
      ylab = "Effect on truant (pp, ref=2010)",
      main = "Probit event-study controls for gender, young/old and substance use")
```

#### \[Logit model\]

```{r}
#fe logit with controls for characteristics and risky behaviour
fe_logit_controls <- feglm(truant ~ survey_year + gender + young_old + smokernow + druguse + i(survey_year, fixest_treatment, ref = 2010) | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, family = "logit", vcov = "hetero")
summary(fe_logit_controls)

iplot(fe_logit_controls, ref.line = 0,
      xlab = "Year",
      ylab = "Effect on truant (pp, ref=2010)",
      main = "Logit event-study controls for gender, young/old and substance use")
```

### Alternative truancy recoding

```{r}
#probit no control
alt_probit_baseline <- feglm(alternative_truant ~ i(survey_year, fixest_treatment, ref = 2010) | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, family = binomial(link="probit"), vcov = "hetero")
summary(alt_probit_baseline)

iplot(alt_probit_baseline, ref.line = 0,
      xlab = "Year",
      ylab = "Effect on truant (pp, ref=2010)",
      main = "Probit event-study alternative truancy no control")

#probit with controls for characteristics
alt_probit_character_controls <- feglm(alternative_truant ~ survey_year + gender + young_old + i(survey_year, fixest_treatment, ref = 2010) | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, family = "probit", vcov = "hetero")
summary(alt_probit_character_controls)

iplot(alt_probit_character_controls, ref.line = 0,
      xlab = "Year",
      ylab = "Effect on truant (pp, ref=2010)",
      main = "Probit event-study alternative truancy control for gender, young/old")

#probit full control
#fe probit with controls for characteristics and risky behaviour
alt_probit_controls <- feglm(alternative_truant ~ survey_year + gender + young_old + smokernow + druguse + i(survey_year, fixest_treatment, ref = 2010) | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, family = "probit", vcov = "hetero")
summary(alt_probit_controls)

iplot(alt_probit_controls, ref.line = 0,
      xlab = "Year",
      ylab = "Effect on truant (pp, ref=2010)",
      main = "Probit alternative truancy event-study full control")
```

## First stage results

### DiD estimation

```{r}
#binary linear everdrink raw
first_stage_did_everdrink_linear_raw <- feols(everdrink ~ did | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, vcov = "hetero")

#continuous linear weeklydrink raw
first_stage_did_weekly_linear_raw <- feols(weekly_drinker ~ did | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, vcov = "hetero")

#binary linear everdrink control
first_stage_did_everdrink_linear_control <- feols(everdrink ~ did + gender + young_old | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, vcov = "hetero")

#continuous linear weeklydrink control
first_stage_did_weekly_linear_control <- feols(weekly_drinker ~ did + gender + young_old | country + survey_year, data = sdd_salsus_all, vcov = "hetero")

summary(first_stage_did_everdrink_linear_raw)
summary(first_stage_did_weekly_linear_raw)
summary(first_stage_did_everdrink_linear_control)
summary(first_stage_did_weekly_linear_control)
```
